Name: Custom Charcoal Kiln
Author: poaskkiliaks
Description:
[size=6]Custom Charcoal Kiln[/size]
Do you frequently struggle to find coal in mines? [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/5f/Magnifying_Glass.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/a7/Coal.png[/img]
Do you frequently have to spend a lot of money buying coal from Clint? [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/36px-Gold.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/36px-Gold.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/36px-Gold.png[/img]
Do you frequently have to waste a lot of wood to have enough coal to melt your ores? [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/df/Wood.png[/img] [size=4][b]==X==> [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/7/78/Copper_Ore.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/8/87/Iron_Ore.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f7/Gold_Ore.png[/img]
[/b][/size]﻿Well, with the Custom Charcoal Kiln, you can solve your problem.

[size=5]Rules
[/size]For creating coal using the Custom Charcoal Kiln, you can use:
1x Driftwood produces 1x Coal in 40 minutes
1x Torch produces 3x Coal in 30 minutes (I know, it's weird that you can have a torch producing more coals in less time, but the Custom Charcoal Kiln won't have to waste time drying the wood before burning it.)
1x Wood [b]NOW[/b] produces 5x Coal in 60 minutes
1x Hardwood produces 45x Coal in 550 minutes (approximately 9 hours)

You can change the rules for balancing the game on your way.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]I tested with:
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22730]WF Atelier Goods - Gourmand[/url] [b][color=#93c47d](OK)[/color][/b]

[size=3]If you find any problem, please report it on bugs channel[/size]

Downloads.Description: First release! Driftwood, Torch, and Hardwood can be used to create Coal.

Manifest.Name: (PFM) Custom Charcoal Kiln
Manifest.Description: Changes the Charcoal Kiln's vanilla behaviour and aggregates recipes for using Driftwood, Hardwood, and Torches as input for coal creation.
